intersections.note: Evans' west face is off the left edge; centre taken 30 ft west of the east face (327), between that and the pipe (160). W 8th's north face is off the top; centre is the south face (629) minus half of the printed 105'. W 8th is printed twice: on the viaduct (y ~280) and on the surface strip south of the viaduct edge (y ~550); one street
Perin (50') from the east ends at Evans, on Evans' slanted stretch; the Evans and Perin pipes meet here
W 6th jogs and changes direction at Evans (sloping WSW west of Evans, level east of it); point is midway between the two W 6th centrelines on the Evans centreline

bends.note: due N-S above, slants SSE below
slants SSE above, due N-S below

ends.note: ends at the Mill Creek bank; drawn with solid faces only from Evans to x ~3950, dashed (laid out, apparently not opened) from there to the creek

notes: Evans (60', printed EVANS) runs down the left side: its west face is off the sheet above y ~2550, so the upper centre comes from the east face and the pipe. Evans is vertical at the top, slants SSE between y ~2430 and ~5035, then vertical again to W 6th (bends recorded). W 8th (printed 105' at Evans) is the viaduct ('Viaduct 2560 ft long') with a surface roadway along its south side; north face off the top edge. Perin (50') runs east from Evans to the Mill Creek. W 6th (50') runs east from Evans to the right edge (continues off sheet). The rest is low marsh ground, Mill Creek Distillery feed barns, the C.H.&D. railroad and the Mill Creek; no other streets.
